ideas.pitch: A direct-to-consumer AgriTech platform connecting small-scale farmers with local urban buyers, featuring real-time logistics and cooperative pricing.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing inefficiencies in agricultural supply chains and low profit margins for small farmers under the AgriTech track.
ideas.title: AgriLink
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the AgriTech track and focuses on clear measurable economic impact for local farmers, a pattern seen in winning community-focused solutions.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support platform providing personalized study roadmaps and collaborative peer study group matching.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing learning gaps and collaboration barriers in higher education under the EdTech track.
ideas.title: PeerMentor AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven multi-agent student support architecture that previously won 1st place at an AI education hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An accessibility-focused HealthTech app that matches nearby elderly or mobility-impaired patients with vetted volunteer drivers for hospital visits.
ideas.problem_statement: Tackling healthcare access and medical transportation barriers for vulnerable populations under the HealthTech track.
ideas.title: MedRoute
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a grand prize-winning concept by delivering clear, quantifiable social good and an intuitive live-working prototype.

ideas.pitch: An E-Commerce copilot that generates hyper-local marketing content and manages inventory predictions for small neighbourhood shops.
ideas.problem_statement: Helping independent merchants compete with large online retailers under the E-Commerce track.
ideas.title: LocalCart AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on immediate economic utility for local vendors, utilizing an AI copilot workflow that heavily appeals to judges looking for real-world impact.

ideas.pitch: A community issue-reporting platform that uses AI to automatically categorize, prioritize, and route local civic problems to municipal authorities.
ideas.problem_statement: Bridging the gap between citizens and local governance under the Open Theme track.
ideas.title: CivicPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs an AI-driven triage workflow that solves a tangible civic problem, echoing winning formats from civic challenge hackathons.
